# Mnemos

> Self-hosted MCP hub that gives all your AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Cursor) one shared
> long-term memory, skills and API credentials, isolated per context (work / personal / side projects).
> Runs on your own machine with Docker; exposed only via Tailscale Funnel with GitHub OAuth.

Built on FastMCP (Python gateway, one per context), Cognee (knowledge-graph memory; Ollama or OpenAI for
extraction), Infisical (secrets, never shown to the model), Vaultwarden, restic backups.
MCP tools: hub_whoami, memory_search, memory_save, memory_list, memory_update, memory_delete,
memory_history, memory_undo, memory_answer, skills_list, skills_get, secrets_list, secret_http_request.

## Install and operate

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): step-by-step install checklist and rules for AI agents
- [README.md](README.md): overview, requirements, quickstart, connecting assistants, configuration, updating, security
- [docs/SETUP.es.md](docs/SETUP.es.md): full setup guide (Spanish)
- [docs/OPERATIONS.es.md](docs/OPERATIONS.es.md): day-to-day operations, tools and their limits (Spanish)
